items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: And Milt Jackson used to tell me, “Once you get past the third chorus you’re practicing.”

ctx.x: And did you get involved in that music in your church as a young boy?

Couldn’t help it. It was part of the environment and you didn’t even think of it as some sort of separate component. It was just the fabric of life. As I look back over it as we see the way things are being broken down, oh yes, Milt Jackson came up in the church and he did this and that’s the reason why he’s playing the vibes the way he plays the vibes. Well when he was coming up he wasn’t thinking about that as something separate and apart from — it’s just a part of the everyday lifestyle. You know you’re…
No kidding. So this would have been —
